name: farsiui-calendar
description: Official Iranian public holidays and optional events for Jalali years. Date conversion is not included — consumers use a Jalali library (e.g. @internationalized/date).

license.note: Curated holiday rows for 1405 follow the official University of Tehran Calendar Center Holiday-1405.pdf. This is not a wholesale copy of any upstream scrape. Non-holiday observances remain unpublished.

sources.description: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran — Calendar Center. Official Holiday-1405.pdf and Calendar-1405.pdf (Council of Public Culture).
Established fixed Jalali national public holidays (Nowruz period, 12 Farvardin, 13 Farvardin, 14–15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand).
MIT Time.ir scrape. Used in an earlier draft; several lunar dates differed by ±1 day from the official UT PDF and were corrected in 1405.2.0.
Time.ir HTML dumps. Not imported; not authoritative vs UT official PDFs.
Per-day dumps with noise/duplicates and no clear license. Not used.

cdn.pinnedRefNote: Prefer @main or a git tag (e.g. calendar-1405.2.0). @latest may lag behind GitHub.

notes: Friday is a weekend day in Iran but is not listed as a holiday item; clients should treat weekends separately.
1405 has 26 official holiday days per Holiday-1405.pdf (some days carry two occasion titles in our items array).
1405 Esfand has 29 days (non-leap in the algorithmic 33-year cycle used by @internationalized/date PersianCalendar).
Do not publish future years' lunar holidays until that year's UT official PDF is available.
Schema is designed for FarsiUI calendar UI to import JSON statically or fetch via jsDelivr.
